supersedes.note: This executable protocol supersedes stale proposal text about pending update-46 attribution. The bounded update-3 outlier attribution is complete and preserved; it did not establish density balance as the cause.

pilot.source: Whole SW0097 positive_frozen seed0 core, registered live encoder/preprocessing, and the completed SW0117 analytic_candidate as the matched retained-density control.
pilot.training_ids: Exact SW0097 ordered 4096-ID sequence; shuffle seed 117.
pilot.optimizer: Fresh Adam with the same encoder/core parameter groups as SW0117.
pilot.lambda_source: Immutable SW0117 seed0 calibration artifact; no recalibration.

objective.sw0119: SW0117 objective minus 10 * plv_balance(phase_PLV) minus 50 * plv_balance(actual_Q)
objective.removed_only: The configured plv_balance term with target density 0.867 is disabled for both phase PLV and actual Q.
objective.terminology: Density-free means removal of the explicit target-density balance term only. The retained collapse prior may still exert density-related pressure.
objective.q: Unchanged positive Pearson product across the actual four-component spike traces after settle=32.
objective.rgb: Unchanged SW0115 decoder-free analytic RGB loss, production .50/min2/largest-component-background partition, exact-forward STE, and native RGB patch means.

required_preflight: Validate the completed SW0117 control manifest, history, optimizer, encoder, full-320 evaluation, source/cache/order/optimizer/coefficient bindings, and reviewed live-encoder source endpoint.
On the first four registered B16 TRAIN batches, preserve SW0117 cache/live gamma and old-loss parity, exact production labels/H, and exact same-input source trace/readout identity.

For phase PLV and actual Q, show that full criterion minus balance-disabled criterion equals the recorded 10*B(PLV)+50*B(Q) contribution; compare gradients of the retained-plus-removed decomposition against the original gradient for encoder, graph, and core.
Require finite nonzero retained-old and RGB gradients for encoder, graph, core, and Q; prove the fixed count-preserving H scramble increases RGB loss.
Prove source core and encoder are unchanged before a separate throwaway B16 Adam update, then verify encoder, graph, and core actually update. No masks or ground truth are read.

promotion.fg_ari: Candidate mean must exceed both the SW0097 seed0 source and matched SW0117 control by at least 0.01.
promotion.paired_bootstrap: Same 320 image indices; deterministic preregistered 10000-draw paired bootstrap. Candidate-minus-control and candidate-minus-source FG-ARI 95% CI lower bounds must both be strictly positive.
promotion.failure: Stop this recipe; no tuning and no seed expansion.

scope: One seed0 pilot. No SW0120 gradient guard, decoder, parameter/readout changes, GT training, reserved-ID access, or automatic fanout.
